ios.desc:
Acryl is a mobile playground for building real apps in SwiftUI. It makes it fun to learn and experiment with SwiftUI code.

Acryl is built to take full advantage of SwiftUI and Swift. It lets you build app's UI with an ease. Just drag & drop UI components to build any interface. Experience it without any interruptions. 

Real Swift and iOS code
• when your UI is ready, just tap share to generate high quality SwiftUI code that you can use in your project. Programming could not be more fun.

Acryl is the interactive documentation for developers. It enables playing with SwiftUI in a completely new way. 

______

Subscription pricing and terms:
Acryl offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $3.49/month to provide you with unlimited access to the Acryl Pro features while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://acrylapp.tech/terms
Privacy policy: https://acrylapp.tech/privacy
